_meta.vintage: CMAP Community Data Snapshots 2026 release (ACS 2020-2024 5-year); lists derived from community_areas.csv on 2026-10-29
_meta.latino_rule: Chicago community areas (the 77) with pct_hispanic > 50 in community_areas.csv
_meta.black_rule: Chicago community areas (the 77) with pct_black_nh > 50 in community_areas.csv
_meta.polish_heritage_rule: Hand-pinned historical Polonia geography (the Northwest Side Polish corridor along Milwaukee Avenue and the adjoining near-northwest suburbs). This is NOT a census majority: no community area or suburb in the table has a Polish-ancestry majority in the ACS, and the CMAP tables do not carry a Polish-ancestry field. Membership is fixed by the audit design.
